process.objective: Implement the Deep Research benchmark recommendations as the Benchmark V1 architecture freeze before collecting real owner pilot, calibration, or sequestered evidence.

decisions.change: Frozen OWNER_PRODUCT_FIT as the V1 construct and made blind holistic owner preference the primary signal: A | B | TIE | BOTH_FAIL | UNCERTAIN plus confidence.
decisions.declared_reason: Deep Research concluded that the immediate target is the owner's product preference, not AI quality, general-audience preference, FoC similarity, or a weighted rubric score.
basis: Deep Research report supplied by the product owner on 2026-09-06
decisions.expected_effect: Prevent rubric or judge proxies from silently redefining what counts as improvement.

decisions.change: Separated first-pass preference from post-vote diagnostics. Owner packets now contain only neutral context, A/B prose, verdict options, confidence, freeze rule, and a reference to a separately gated post-vote artifact.
decisions.declared_reason: Static review found that embedding diagnostic prompts in the same raw packet could still prime the owner even if the protocol said they should be hidden until after voting.
decisions.expected_effect: Enforce preference-before-diagnosis at the data boundary rather than relying only on operator discipline.

decisions.change: Created a standalone failure-signature contract with SPAN | MULTI_SPAN | UNIT_GLOBAL scope, RESOLVED | UNRESOLVED state, one primary family, contributes_to, and root_cause constrained to null.
decisions.declared_reason: The benchmark must create a clean output-side failure node for later white-box tracing without prematurely blaming Planner, Writer, Evidence, or another module.
decisions.expected_effect: Make output failures traceable while keeping root-cause attribution downstream.

decisions.change: Frozen a six-family Product taxonomy: NARRATIVE_FUNCTION, EXPOSITION_LOAD, SPOKEN_COMPREHENSION, GROUNDING_SPECIFICITY, VOICE_STANCE, REDUNDANCY, with anti-double-counting rules.
decisions.declared_reason: The previous dimension/defect vocabulary could double-count the same symptom and treat essay-like behavior as several supposedly independent failures.
decisions.expected_effect: Keep diagnostics small, observable, and suitable for binary fault isolation later.

decisions.change: Introduced eval_unit as the benchmark primitive with historical_topic, editorial_function, granularity, modality, and evidence_condition; granularities are FUNCTION_CLIP, SECTION_SENTINEL, EPISODE_SENTINEL.
decisions.declared_reason: Clip-only optimization can Goodhart locally while degrading section or episode flow, and evaluation units should be editorial-function based rather than fixed word-count based.
decisions.expected_effect: Support function/topic/granularity slices and later macro sentinels.

decisions.change: Strengthened claim-level Truth semantics with implied-premise/causal claim types, verifiability, source relation, materiality and release blockers; created an independent Spoken lane for TEXT_PREDICTION, AUDIO_OBSERVATION, and LISTENER_REPORT.
decisions.declared_reason: Round-01 truth review overapproved hidden premises and causal claims, while text-only listenability judgments were being asked to stand in for actual listening evidence.
basis: Deep Research factuality and spoken-evidence recommendations
decisions.expected_effect: Make factual and spoken claims match the evidence actually available without suppressing Product preference measurement.

decisions.change: Demoted every historical/public P01 sample to DEV, converted the three existing owner pairs to PILOT, and replaced public HOLDOUT semantics with a private/restricted SEQUESTERED lifecycle plus REFRESHED_SEQUESTERED after tuning exposure.
decisions.declared_reason: Historical P01 material has been repeatedly exposed during harness/evaluator design and cannot provide blind validity evidence; a public repository cannot contain a genuinely sequestered payload and labels.
decisions.expected_effect: Prevent contaminated development material from being mistaken for out-of-sample validation.

decisions.change: Formalized LLM judges as SHADOW_ONLY until out-of-sample owner validation passes pre-registered reliability gates; kept FoC hidden during primary preference and available only for post-vote functional target-gap analysis; removed global score, Elo, and Bradley-Terry requirements from V1.
decisions.declared_reason: Deep Research found substantial judge bias risk and warned that reference visibility and small-sample ranking models can create anchoring or false precision.
basis: Deep Research LLM-judge, reference-bias, and aggregation recommendations
decisions.expected_effect: Keep proxy evaluators and craft references subordinate to the owner/product construct until independently validated.

implementation_steps.action: Frozen Iteration 04 work order on a safety sub-branch before edits.
implementation_steps.observed_result: Deep Research recommendations became bounded implementation requirements before architecture changes began.

implementation_steps.action: Split benchmark responsibilities into standalone evaluation schemas and deprecated the monolithic output-quality schema.
implementation_steps.observed_result: Product preference, diagnostics, Truth, Spoken, Target Gap, and judge reliability no longer share one evaluator object.

implementation_steps.action: Frozen six-family Product taxonomy and added an explicit pilot evaluation unit.
implementation_steps.observed_result: Diagnostics now support macro scope, one primary family, unresolved classification, and no upstream root-cause claim.

implementation_steps.action: Reclassified all shared/public historical P01 evidence as DEV and rewrote source roles accordingly.
implementation_steps.observed_result: The former calibration candidates and former HOLDOUT are explicitly exposed DEV material.

implementation_steps.action: Added public sequestered metadata shell and initialized an unvalidated shadow-judge state.
implementation_steps.observed_result: No private validation prose or labels are represented as present in the public repository; judge has no optimization authority.

implementation_steps.action: Converted the three historical owner pairs to pilot-only preference packets with BOTH_FAIL, confidence and freeze semantics.
implementation_steps.observed_result: Current pairs test protocol usability only and cannot be used as benchmark-validity evidence.

implementation_steps.action: Static review found pre-vote priming risk because optional diagnostic prompts were still embedded in the same raw owner packet; moved them to a separately gated post-vote artifact and tightened verifier checks.
implementation_steps.observed_result: First-pass packet boundaries now physically exclude post-vote diagnostic prompts; the separate artifact requires preference freeze before visibility.

implementation_steps.action: Updated active Phase 1 routing, measurement contract, protocol, Worker loop, Worker iteration schema, and structural verifier for Benchmark V1.3.
implementation_steps.observed_result: Active Phase 1 documentation no longer routes work through the legacy six-dimension/shared-holdout architecture.

validations.command: Static GitHub connector inspection of changed schemas/data/docs against Iteration 04 work order and Deep Research architecture
validations.observed_result: Confirmed preference-first isolation, BOTH_FAIL/confidence, separate post-vote diagnostics, six-family taxonomy, evaluation-unit granularity, semantic Truth fields, Spoken lane, DEV-only public P01 history, public/private sequestered boundary, SHADOW_ONLY judge, post-vote FoC, and no mandatory scalar/BT/Elo aggregation.
The available container could not resolve github.com, so checkout failed before verifier execution. No synthetic runtime PASS was recorded.

deviations: Implementation used sub-branch codex/p01-phase1-benchmark-v1-freeze as a safety branch before fast-forwarding the parent Phase 1 branch.
Historical owner packets remain under the existing calibration/owner-packets path for provenance compatibility, but their semantic role is PILOT_ONLY_NOT_CALIBRATION_EVIDENCE.

A static review revision physically separated post-vote prompts from first-pass packets; this was stricter than the initial work-order wording but consistent with the preference-before-diagnostics invariant.
No fresh calibration labels, LLM judge results, or private sequestered payload were fabricated.

Run the three historical owner packets only as protocol/usability pilots.
Create a fresh calibration corpus across multiple editorial functions after pilot usability is confirmed.
Select/freeze one LLM shadow judge and prompt only after the fresh calibration design stabilizes.
Pre-register judge acceptance tolerances before opening any private/restricted sequestered set.

deliverables.role: public metadata shell for private/restricted validation evidence
owner pilot state and future calibration metrics
diagnostic prompts visible only after preference freeze

measurement_design.primary_evaluation: Blind first-pass owner A|B|TIE|BOTH_FAIL|UNCERTAIN preference with LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH confidence, frozen before diagnostics, Truth results, shadow-judge predictions, or craft references.
measurement_design.diagnostic_method: Post-vote failure signatures with one primary family from a six-family taxonomy, SPAN|MULTI_SPAN|UNIT_GLOBAL scope, explicit RESOLVED|UNRESOLVED state, contributes_to, and root_cause=null.
measurement_design.truth_method: Independent claim-level audit with claim type, verifiability, source relation, materiality and release blocker; Truth cannot be traded numerically against Product preference.
measurement_design.spoken_method: Independent TEXT_PREDICTION, AUDIO_OBSERVATION and LISTENER_REPORT evidence levels; text-only judgments cannot certify actual listening outcomes.
measurement_design.target_gap_method: FoC/reference appears only after preference freeze, is matched by editorial function, cannot change the frozen vote, and cannot use style similarity as a score.

dataset_partitions.dev: All historical P01 material currently present in the public/shared repository.
dataset_partitions.pilot: Three DEV-derived owner A/B packets used only to test preference-first protocol usability.
dataset_partitions.calibration: Not populated; must be fresh owner-labelled pairs collected after pilot protocol stability.
dataset_partitions.sequestered: Private/restricted payload not yet created; public repository contains metadata shell only.
dataset_partitions.refreshed_sequestered: Required whenever a previous sequestered set has been opened and used for tuning.

output.craft_corpus_coverage: Eight transcript-only FoC excerpts across two episodes remain available for post-vote function-matched target-gap analysis only.

verifier_result.observed_result: Verifier was rewritten for Benchmark V1.3, but runtime execution could not be performed because the available container could not resolve github.com for checkout. Static connector review passed; no runtime PASS is claimed.

known_limitations: Current pilot pairs are historical exposed DEV material and cannot establish benchmark validity.
Fresh calibration corpus has not been collected.
No LLM judge has been selected or validated; SHADOW_ONLY remains ineligible for optimization.
No private/restricted sequestered payload or labels exist yet.
No transfer evidence exists on new historical topics, section sentinels, or episode sentinels.
Audio/listener validation has not been run.
Structural verifier has not yet run in a full repository checkout/CI environment.
output.summary: Benchmark V1.3 now encodes the Deep Research architecture as enforceable data boundaries: owner preference first, diagnostics after freeze, independent Truth/Spoken/Target-Gap lanes, DEV-only public P01 history, private/restricted sequestered lifecycle, and SHADOW_ONLY LLM judges. The next valid step is owner protocol pilot plus runtime verification, not another rubric rewrite or Writer round.
